text: Good morning!  How are you today?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: Doing good. how about you?

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: I'm doing well.  Thanks for asking.

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: Have you heard about a children's charity called Save the children?

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: No, I'm not aware of that charity.  Can you share any information about it with me?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: It is an International non-governmental organization that promotes children's right and provides relief and support for children in developing countries. Those children suffer from hunger and they don't have any access to education

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: That sounds like a cool organization.  Is it headquartered in the United States?  How does the organization get its funding?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: The organization funds itself. We don't get any help from the government so we really need your help. Any donation can make a great impact for those kids.

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: Is there any reason why the organization doesn't want grants or other funding from the government?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: Because we believe that when society works together we can achieve great result. We try not to burden the government and hopefully we can do it. 90% of your donation will go straight to the children and we try to keep the cost as low as possible

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: Can you give examples of how donations are used?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: In US, we help kids in poverty and those who cross our southern border. We help them from family separation and detention. In Asia, we help the kids from Rohingya which is traumatic and need a lot of support since the ethnic war in the country.

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: Okay, but what are some specific examples of where the funds go to help these children?  For example, do you buy food, clothing, and emergency supplies?  That's what I'm asking.

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: In Rohingya, we set up a camp and provide food, emergency supplies, clean water and shelter for the families there. we helped 30,000 people move to a safer place and we built some infrastructure to help the country recover

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: That's amazing work!  What about in the US?

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: Since 1932, Save the Children has been on the ground providing support to the most isolated and underserved children in rural America. We provide food and help them with education through our home visiting program. We help relief the kids in disaster area since Hurricane Katrina and provide those kids with shelter and a safe place.

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: Wow, I wasn't aware the organization had been in existence for so long.

speaker: A16184N1RO5OJV
text: Yes we are. I know we need more publicity

speaker: AXKHXDBKN7DM0
text: Yes, I think that would be very helpful in order for the organization to get more donations.

text: Can you donate a few cents? It will help us a lot
